overview: The commission met without a quorum to discuss local safety incidents, upcoming community events, and infrastructure updates from the Transportation Director. No formal votes were taken, but the group reviewed plans for new bike lanes on Park Street and Lawrence Road.

items.title: Call to Order and Administrative Tabled Items
items.summary: Meeting called to order with only three members present; no formal votes or decisions could be made, including the approval of minutes.

items.title: Announcements and Safety Incidents
items.summary: Members discussed a life-threatening hit-and-run involving a pedestrian at Harvard and Winchester Streets and a separate crash at Harvard and Arlington, noting the need for better safety data and infrastructure advocacy.

items.title: Farmer's Market and Community Outreach
items.summary: The commission reviewed their recent tabling at the Medford Farmer's Market and discussed the utility of educational handouts regarding defensive cycling.

items.title: Infrastructure Projects and State Agency Coordination
items.summary: The group discussed the construction of a MassDOT shared-use path underpass at Route 28 and debated strategies for better communication with state agencies during the design phase of projects.

items.title: Event Planning and Tabling
items.summary: Members coordinated volunteer staffing for upcoming events including Tufts Community Day, the Harvest Your Energy Festival, and a local Maker's Fair.

items.title: Digital Administration and Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Updates were provided on the commission's website and Google Drive organization, while a discussion regarding shifting the November and December meeting dates was deferred.

items.title: Transportation Department Project Updates
items.summary: Chris relayed reports from Transportation Director Todd Blake regarding an upcoming contraflow lane on Park Street, the 17th Blue Bike station installation, and potential bike lane feasibility on Lawrence Road and Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Membership Recruitment and Board Roles
items.summary: The commission discussed the need for geographically diverse new members and reviewed a draft document outlining the responsibilities of various board positions.
